<!--
Use this single template for every new issue. Replace the guidance in the comments with concise,
task-specific details. Keep secrets, tokens, credentials, and sensitive logs out of the issue.
-->

## Issue type

<!-- Feature, bug fix, refactor, documentation, test, configuration, migration, or other. -->

## Problem

<!-- What is missing, broken, or difficult today? Who or what is affected? Include useful evidence. -->

## Goals

<!-- What should be true when this issue is complete? -->

-

## Non-goals

<!-- What related work is intentionally outside this issue? -->

-

## Requirements and acceptance criteria

<!-- Describe observable behavior or outcomes that determine completion. -->

- [ ]

## Relevant context

<!-- Link related issues, documentation, code paths, designs, or reproduction steps. -->

## Proposed approach

<!-- Add implementation notes, affected boundaries, or open design questions when known. -->

## Validation

<!-- Explain how the change will be tested or verified. Record results when the work is complete. -->

## Risks and rollback

<!-- Note compatibility, security, migration, or operational risks and the recovery plan. -->

## Follow-ups

<!-- Capture intentionally deferred work, unresolved questions, or decisions needed from a human. -->
